reviews.title: Great keyboard
reviews.comment: This keyboard feels high quality and types smoothly, i’ve had a few mechanical keyboards and this one surely is the best i’ve owned.
reviews.author: Samuel

reviews.title: Nice gaming and work keyboard
reviews.comment: pretty good. had the apex pro V3, essentially the same minus the actuation controls and omni point switches for half the price. this one takes up two usb ports which is not the best but still. worth it for someone who likes the true mechanical TKL Style keyboard with out paying too much money. definitely worth it if you’re in between.
reviews.author: Random

reviews.title: Integrated wire and reliable operation
reviews.comment: One of the few remaining TKL per RGB keyboards that still uses an integrated cable instead of a disconnectable usb-c.  The lady of the house kept having issues with the usb-c ones and having to unplug and plug back in.  I wish they made this with the yellow - laser/light switches that they have in their 9 series that she liked but oh-well, she is happier with a reliable keyboard even if the switches are a little different.
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.title: Good but poorly build
reviews.comment: Second one that I buy in less than a year easily broken for the price for me it could be better but I love the keyboard by any reason
reviews.author: Herincho

reviews.title: Awesome Small Gaming Keyboard
reviews.comment: Great little keyboard for gaming! It’s compact, responsive, and the lights look really cool. Perfect for saving space and still getting a good gaming experience. Definitely worth it!
reviews.author: Jonathan
